name: Report generation
summary: Turning a report request into a rendered file: queuing, rendering, completion callbacks back to the owning service, and failure handling.

nfr.statement: Time from requesting a report to the file being ready, per report type and project size.
nfr.open_question: What generation time do customers expect, and when should the UI say "we'll email you" instead?

nfr.statement: Today a completion callback is attempted 4 times (immediately, then after 5 seconds, 30 seconds and 5 minutes), each with a 10-second timeout, before giving up.
nfr.open_question: Is giving up after about 5½ minutes acceptable, and who is alerted when a callback is finally lost?

requirements.title: Reports are queued, rendered, stored, then reported back
requirements.statement: A report request is saved as a job, then queued by priority. The worker checks for cancellation, marks the job processing, renders the requested mode, stores the PDF, screenshot and metadata, and marks it completed before calling the owning service back. On an error it marks the job failed and attempts a failure callback.
open_checks: No production branch for t3d-report-service, and the external construction-reports implementation isn't mapped; runtime flag and queue routing are unverified
The collab-service report callback mount order contradicts its comment; verify sender authentication and reachability
Global auth is commented out in the cached legacy report service index; establish which paths are reachable and who may act

acceptance_criteria.given: A report job is cancelled before the worker picks it up
acceptance_criteria.then: Nothing is rendered, and the job stays cancelled
The job is marked failed and a failure callback is attempted

requirements.title: The newer renderer is behind an environment flag
requirements.statement: The newer report path is used only when an environment setting equals "true"; otherwise the legacy renderer runs. Which projects and environments use which renderer isn't known.

acceptance_criteria.then: (Current behaviour) The legacy renderer is used, because only "true" turns the new one on

requirements.title: Completion callbacks are tried four times
requirements.statement: The report service calls the owner back up to 4 times (immediately, then after 5 seconds, 30 seconds and 5 minutes), each with a 10-second timeout. It then reports the callback as undelivered with the last error.

acceptance_criteria.given: The owner's callback endpoint is down
acceptance_criteria.then: The callback is tried 4 times over about 5½ minutes, then marked undelivered

requirements.title: The owner acknowledges and claims "notified" before emailing
requirements.statement: The owning service acknowledges a callback before finishing its own work, and claims the job as notified before the email is sent. If the email then fails, nothing resends it. A completed result can follow a failed one, but a failed result after completion is ignored.
open_checks: Prove reconciliation after the owner's own handling or email delivery fails following acknowledgment

acceptance_criteria.given: A completed-report callback is acknowledged and the job is claimed as notified
acceptance_criteria.then: (Current behaviour) The requester isn't emailed, and no retry happens
